1124-2232-2781-8327.easyPrerequisites: You are able to activate one of Feroz's loyalty abilities this turn.
1124-2232-2781-8327.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Feroz's second loyalty ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, causing you to draw a card and put Felidar Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Feroz.
When Feroz enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Activate Feroz's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Bird creature tokens with flying.
When the Birds enter, Cloudstone Curio triggers. Choose to return Felidar Guardian from the battlefield to your hand with one trigger, and nothing to your hand with the other trigger.
Repeat from step 2

2511-3652-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
2511-3652-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ornithopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

710-4050-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-4050-8207.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1339-2835-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

2577-3967-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-3967-6763-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1981-2324-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

765-1315-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

1245-1475-6258.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-6258.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat.

2292-3240-5477-6462.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token, a 1/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

757-3094-4348.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

2060-2926-3525-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Traveling Minister does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Traveling Minister.
2060-2926-3525-6996.description:
Activate Traveling Minister by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Traveling Minister.
Repeat.

2034-4120-4186-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
2034-4120-4186-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7157.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Lancer enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

132-2024-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green or white is at least 4.
132-2024-4306.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/W}{G/W}{G/W}{G/W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G/W}{G/W}, untapping Myr Welder and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

132-2645-4851.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
If Staff of Domination is exiled, activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Otherwise, activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Myr Welder. Then, activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-4851.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities.

5941-6790.manaNeeded: {2}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
5941-6790.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
5941-6790.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pyromancer's Goggles by tapping it, adding {R}.
Cast Wild Ricochet by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Pyromancer's Goggles triggers, copying Wild Ricochet, with the copy targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Resolve the copy of Wild Ricochet, creating a copy of Wild Ricochet targeting the original Wild Ricochet.
Repeat step 5.

1445-5295-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5295-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

250-5671.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size, one of which must be a land card.
250-5671.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard a land and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return a land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1308-4067-5742-5743.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

509-1267-2003-5517.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each even-numbered extra turn
509-1267-2003-5517.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Medomai the Ageless has a +1/+1 counter on it.
509-1267-2003-5517.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat steps 5 through 8 one additional time.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two time counters on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

2792-5140-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}.
2792-5140-5231.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Great Whale, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1393-4986-5034-5231.manaNeeded: {1} if the permanent requires three or more mana to cast
1393-4986-5034-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast using {C}{R}{R}.
1393-4986-5034-5231.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {R}.
Cast the historic permanent from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {R}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 3.
1393-4986-5034-5231.notes: If the historic permanent can be cast for less than {C}{R}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2034-3490-4505.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3490-4505.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an additional creature, adding {2}.
When the creature dies, Feral Ghoul's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Feral Ghoul, you may sacrifice it to give opponents infinite rad counters, which will cause them to mill their library and lose a large amount of life during their next precombat main phase.

1651-2645-4306-4824.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least three.
1651-2645-4306-4824.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Basalt Monolith, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

49-2707-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

4218-4875.description: Activate The World Tree's second ability by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search for all creatures in your library, as they are all Gods due to Conspiracy and put them onto the battlefield.

678-1872-4985.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2034-2267-4484-4871.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-2267-4484-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2769-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
2769-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

893-1651-3459.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Battered Golem and the Myr token, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

1656-2060-5194.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze has at least seven +1/+1 counters on it.
1656-2060-5194.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Dragonsguard Elite's ability by paying {4}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze six times using Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing six +1/+1 counters from Necrotic Ooze, adding {4}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

632-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper and Sacrecrone do not have summoning sickness.
632-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
